author: TEDx Talks
description:
What can medical aid in dying teach us, not just about dying, but also about living? In this deeply personal and moving talk, writer and teacher Taffy Field shares her family’s experience navigating Maine’s Death with Dignity Act, underscoring the possibilities of agency and acceptance it affords. 

Taffy Field has built her life at the intersection of sustainability, education, and community, from raising a family on an organic farm and co-founding a natural foods store to teaching energy-efficient design and high school English. Her path took a profound turn when her husband Eliot chose to access Maine’s Death With Dignity Act, a decision that reshaped her understanding of agency, resilience, and love. Today, Taffy works to protect Maine’s law and advocate for similar legislation nationwide, helping ensure others can face life’s end with dignity and choice.
